svg.text: Base: 6 mm plate 580 x 520 with a 150 hole in the centre and twelve

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 9 mm holes for the studs on the bank box top, 15 in from the edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Walls: 2 mm sheet, 520 x 460 outside, 260 tall, welded to the base.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top flange: 25 mm wide, 3 mm, round the top outside, with eight

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 7 mm holes for the lid bolts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 25 x 3 support bars across the inside, 240 apart, tops 54 above

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the base: the tube bank rests on them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bulkhead union holes, 13 mm: left end 190 behind the centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 212 above the base; right end 152 in front, 60 above the base.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drain: 12 mm hole in the left end, 14 above the base, and a 20 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stub with a valve. Flue water is acid: stainless valve.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The outlet union feeds the evaporator bank, not the coil.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the base sits flat on the bank box; the lid seats all round.
